# Addis Luxury — E-Commerce & Haute Couture Platform

> Addis Luxury is an elite bespoke fashion house and luxury apparel maison co-founded by visionaries from Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates. We fuse ancient Ethiopian handweaving traditions with Arabian couture craftsmanship, hosting a global ready-to-wear boutique and bespoke tailoring service.

## Core Information
- Official Website: https://www.addisluxury.com
- Flagship Salons: Addis Ababa (Bole Road, Ethiopia) & Dubai (Fashion Avenue, The Dubai Mall, UAE)
- E-Commerce Offerings: Women's Couture, Men's Bespoke Tailoring, UAE Limited Editions, Ethiopian Craft Line, Handwoven Silk Accessories
- Client Concierge: hello@addisluxury.com | +971 4 362 7500 | +251 11 661 8800

## Key Services & Currencies
- Supported Currencies: USD ($), UAE Dirham (AED), Ethiopian Birr (ETB)
- Fulfillment: Complimentary worldwide DHL Express insured courier delivery in handcrafted wooden preservation boxes, or private salon fitting & collection in Addis Ababa / Dubai.
